role: VoiceConversationController TTS side: speak() with output scrub, hallucination guard, 'Flo here. <Model>.' preamble and TTS normalization; ensurePermissions (via VoicePermissionGate); buildSystemPrompt (via VoiceCoachPrompt); the AVSpeechSynthesizerDelegate that restores state/re-arms listening after speech; barge-in detection and echo wrappers; ConversationVoicePicker for the TTS voice; file-private perimeterScrubbed. VoicePermissionGate (speech/mic permission checks and their messages) and VoiceCoachPrompt (the interjection system prompt text) are separate enums in this file.
types: VoiceConversationController: extension — TTS, ensurePermissions, buildSystemPrompt, barge-in
ConversationVoicePicker: enum — preferred language and best installed voice (cached)
VoicePermissionGate: enum (@MainActor) — speech-recognition then microphone permission checks, returning the localized refusal
VoiceCoachPrompt: enum — persona + hard-rules system prompt for interjections
state: utterance rate = default*0.96, zero pre/post delay
listen-after-drain delay 1.2 s; restart-after-stop delay 100 ms
toplevel: Private static let prompt strings VoiceCoachPrompt.persona/hardRules; AVSpeechSynthesizerDelegate conformance; ConversationVoicePicker.cache initialised empty on first access; file-private perimeterScrubbed.

units.does: Speaks a chunk: picks the override or best voice, runs CoachVoiceGuard scrub then the hallucination guard, adds the one-time 'Flo here. <Model>.' preamble unless scripted or in .triggerSpeaking, normalizes for TTS (English expansions only when the voice that will speak is English: the chosen voice's language, or the device's current language when no voice is chosen and the system default speaks) and enqueues via FRSafeSpeak. On failure it logs, drops the chunk and settles a scripted trigger line that will never get a didFinish (settleUnspokenTriggerLine).

branches.effect: the device's current language code decides whether English expansions apply
scripted → guarded text as-is; else announced(guarded) adds preamble once per session
return; else log warning, chunk skipped, settleUnspokenTriggerLine()

units.does: After speak failed to queue a line: if the state is .triggerSpeaking, no interjection llmTask is running and the synthesizer is silent (so no didFinish is coming), calls finishTriggerSpeech to play the next queued trigger or restore the pre-trigger state; otherwise does nothing (an interjection is settled by finishInterjection, a reply chunk by the reply's own finish).

branches.cond: not .triggerSpeaking, llmTask set, or synthesizer still speaking

units.does: Builds an AVSpeechUtterance from attributed text with the voice, 0.96x default rate, pitch 1, volume 1, zero pre/post delay.
First non-scripted chunk of a session: sets hasAnnouncedSubsystem and prefixes '<voiceAnnouncement> <Model>.'; later chunks unchanged.
Stops the synthesizer immediately via the FRSafeStopSpeaking shim.
Maps the responding provider to a short spoken model tag: Apple, first word of the Anthropic/OpenAI model display name, or fixed Gemini/Grok/DeepSeek.
Returns provider/model of the active assistant turn being spoken (registry display name for its modelID, or provider name), else the picker's active provider and model display name.

branches.cond: no active index / out of range / turn has no providerID

units.does: Applies live-workout numeric corrections then app-state corrections to the text.
If a live workout snapshot exists, verifies numeric claims, logs and records corrections, and substitutes the actual values back-to-front.
calls: closure:liveWorkoutSnapshotProvider set by the workout recorder

branches.cond: no snapshot provider or nil snapshot

units.does: Verifies app-state claims (TSB/ATL/CTL/ACWR/RMSSD/recovery); when discrepancies exist logs, records them and returns the corrected text.
Push-to-talk commit: only in .listening, finalizes the current user turn.
External Stop hook: bumps responseSpeakGeneration, stops TTS, resets chunker, drops observers and cursor; if mid-response (speaking/thinking) and not in a full stop, schedules a listening restart.
units.entry: AssistantViewModel.cancel() (AssistantViewModel.swift:581): chat Stop button, stop(), interrupt()

units.does: After 100 ms, if not fully stopping and still speaking/thinking, launches beginUserTurn.

branches.effect: return (idle after stop, or already listening)

units.does: Requires speech-recognition authorization, then microphone permission (VoicePermissionGate.denialMessage); on a refusal stores the localized reason in permissionError and returns false.
Returns the voice-coach persona + hard rules system prompt used for interjections (VoiceCoachPrompt.interjectionPrompt).
Synth didStart: on the main actor stamps ttsStartedAt when nil or older than 5 s (barge-in grace anchor).

branches.cond: ttsStartedAt nil or older than 5 s
branches.effect: set to now; else keep (so consecutive chunks within 5 s keep the first anchor)

units.does: Synth didFinish: on the main actor, if the synth queue is empty, finishes trigger speech (triggerSpeaking, no interjection task) or response speech (speaking, no interjection task).

After a trigger line: drains the next pending trigger if any; otherwise restores the pre-trigger state — re-listen after audio drain if it was listening, speaking, or another trigger's line that was about to hand back to listening (.triggerSpeaking), else .idle.

branches.effect: drain one and return (if busy, nothing plays and state stays .triggerSpeaking)
scheduleListenAfterAudioDrain; else state=.idle (a prior .starting also lands in .idle)

units.does: After the synth drains during a reply: waits if the view model is still streaming or the chunker still holds text; drains a pending trigger if any; else schedules listening after the audio drain.
Sleeps 1.2 s then calls resumeListeningIfStillQuiet.
If the synth is quiet and state is still speaking/triggerSpeaking, launches beginUserTurn; otherwise does nothing.

Barge-in check (silence-timer tick): only while speaking with audio playing, after the 0.6 s grace, with RMS above 0.018 for 0.3 s, at least 2 new recognised words, and the new text not an echo of the streamed reply → interrupt().
units.entry: Called by silenceTimerTick (Audio:191) on the silence Timer

branches.cond: no sub-threshold stamp or loud for < 0.3 s

units.does: Word count via VoiceEchoHeuristics.wordCount.
Echo test of a barge-in candidate against currentResponseText (in-flight threshold 0.65).
Compares a finalized transcript against the last assistant turn's text using VoiceEchoHeuristics.looksLikeEcho.
Token overlap ratio pass-through used by the medical-refusal echo trap.
Returns 'en-US' when forceAIEnglish is set, else the app language's (LanguageManager.appLocale) maximal identifier — the language the recognizer listens in and the AI replies in.
Returns the cached voice for the language, else the best installed matching voice (logged), else the system voice for the language, else en-US; caches non-nil results per language for the launch.
Logs the chosen voice and, when its quality is .default, a tip to install enhanced voices; returns it.

Keeps installed voices of the same language (language code after expanding both tags), excluding novelty and personal voices, and returns the one ranked highest by rank(_:for:): script match, then region match, then quality, then non-'.compact.'.

branches.cond: voice language differs, novelty or personal voice

branches.effect: max returns nil; ties keep the first candidate

units.does: Sort key for a candidate voice against the wanted language: [same script, same region, quality rank, not compact], each larger-is-better, compared lexicographically by bestInstalledVoice.
Expands a BCP-47 tag to its maximal form (likely script and region added, e.g. zh-HK → zh-Hant-HK, en → en-Latn-US) and stores its language code, script and region identifiers.
Rank: premium 3, enhanced 2, default 1, unknown 0.
Name for voice quality: premium/enhanced/default/unknown.
Speech recognition first (speechRecognitionDenial), then the microphone (micDenial); nil when both are granted, else the localized reason. The mic is not checked once speech recognition is refused.
Localized 'Speech Recognition permission was not granted.'
Logs the SFSpeechRecognizer authorization status: authorized → nil; notDetermined → shows the system prompt (requestSpeechAuthorization); denied/restricted/unknown → the localized reason.
Shows the speech-recognition prompt (SFSpeechRecognizer.requestAuthorization via a @Sendable continuation callback) and logs the result; nil when authorized, else notGranted.

Logs the AVAudioApplication record permission: granted → nil; undetermined → shows the prompt and returns nil or 'Microphone permission was not granted.'; denied → 'Microphone access is denied…'; unknown → 'Microphone permission was not granted.'

branches.effect: prompt; nil when granted, else micNotGranted

units.does: String name for an SFSpeechRecognizerAuthorizationStatus (logging).
String name for an AVAudioApplication.recordPermission (logging).

The persona (voice coach read aloud by TTS; be specific — anchored to a CONTEXT number — or be silent) followed by the hard rules (only CONTEXT data, never issue commands, user can interrupt), joined by a blank line.
If CoachVoiceGuard finds prohibited language, scrubs it and logs each trigger; otherwise returns text unchanged.
